definitions.gloss: defensive position; being on the defense; defensive stance
definitions.explanation: A state of defending or being forced to react rather than take the initiative. Used in military, sports, political, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
examples.english: To be put on the defensive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされた。
examples.english: We were forced onto the defensive in the second half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{追及|ついきゅう}→追及：09148_tsuikyuu⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{終始|しゅうし}→終始：15291_shuushi⟧{守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧、⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けた→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: Facing harsh questioning from the opposition, the government remained on the defensive throughout and avoided giving concrete answers.

notes:
A compound of {守|しゅ} (defense, to guard) and {勢|せい} (force, posture). Almost always appears in the phrase {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to be put on the defensive) or {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to take a defensive stance). The opposite is {攻勢|こうせい} (offensive).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to be on the defensive
- {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}たされる: to be forced onto the defensive
- {守勢|しゅせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to take a defensive position
- ⟦{終始|しゅうし}→終始：15291_shuushi⟧{守勢|しゅせい}: on the defensive throughout

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {攻勢|こうせい}: offensive — the opposite, taking the initiative to attack or push forward
- ⟦{防衛|ぼうえい}→防衛：09783_bouei⟧: defense — broader term for defense, especially national defense
- ⟦{受|う}け{身|み}→受け身：19674_ukemi⟧: passive, reactive — a general term for being in a reactive position
